AddLoopOp.description:
Create a saved practice loop (M2.11, spec §13.2.1).

The name defaults to "Loop N" and the color to the default loop
color server-side. The repository validates
``0 ≤ start < end ≤ duration_frames`` (422 ``LOOP_RANGE_INVALID``).
``repeat_count`` is the total number of passes; ``None`` = infinite.
AddLoopOp.title: AddLoopOp

PracticeLoop.description:
A saved practice loop with integer source-frame boundaries (spec §13.1).

``repeat_count`` is the total number of passes (not "extra repeats");
``None`` means infinite. ``boundary_fade`` enables the short output
fades at the join (§13.6); disabling them gives exact boundary
audition. The boundaries are exact source frames and are never
expanded (§13.3.5–6).

id.description: UUID identifier, serialized as a string
id.title: Id

Per-project mixer and practice state (spec §3.5).

``tracks`` is keyed by stem role value (``StemRole``). Stem playback
modes require an active result set; ``original`` plays the source mix
and may still remember the last result set.

SetActiveLoopOp.description:
Select the active loop; ``null`` clears the selection (M2.11 §13.2.9).

Clearing also disables looping (the ``loop_enabled requires an
active loop`` invariant). Selecting a different loop keeps looping
enabled.

anyOf.description: UUID identifier, serialized as a string

SetActiveLoopOp.title: SetActiveLoopOp

SetActiveResultSetOp.description:
Select the project's active separation result set (M2.7, §9.4.3).

``null`` clears the selection. The target must be a result set of
the same project (validated by the repository, not here — this op
is data, not a query). Undoable: it is part of the history.

anyOf.description: UUID identifier, serialized as a string

SetActiveResultSetOp.title: SetActiveResultSetOp

SetLoopEnabledOp.description:
Enable or disable repeated practice playback (M2.11 §13.2.10, §13.4).

Enabling requires an active loop of at least
:data:`MIN_REPEATABLE_LOOP_SECONDS` (spec §13.3.3): the repository
pre-validates and raises ``NoActiveLoopError`` (409) or
``LoopTooShortError`` (409, message names the 100 ms minimum).
SetLoopEnabledOp.title: SetLoopEnabledOp

SetMasterGainOp.description: Set the master monitoring gain (M2.8, spec §10.3).
SetMasterGainOp.title: SetMasterGainOp

SetMonitoringLimiterOp.description: Enable or disable the monitoring-path limiter (M2.8, spec §10.6).
SetMonitoringLimiterOp.title: SetMonitoringLimiterOp

SetPlaybackModeOp.description:
Select the playback mode (M2.8, spec §10.4.5–6).

Stem modes require an active result set; the repository pre-validates
and raises ``PlaybackModeRequiresResultSetError`` (409) when none is
active.
SetPlaybackModeOp.title: SetPlaybackModeOp

SetPlaybackSpeedOp.description:
Set the pitch-preserving playback speed (M2.9, spec §11).

Writes ``practice_state.playback_speed``. Undoable: like the other
mixer ops it is part of the history (not in
``HISTORY_EXCLUDED_TYPES``). Speed is independent of the result set,
so there is no pre-validation beyond the range (422 on violation).
SetPlaybackSpeedOp.title: SetPlaybackSpeedOp

SetPositionOp.description: Continuous playback position — persisted, never in history (§17.4.10).
SetPositionOp.title: SetPositionOp

SetSelectionOp.description: Both null clears the selection; present together otherwise.
SetSelectionOp.title: SetSelectionOp

SetTrackSettingsOp.description:
Patch one stem track's mixer settings (M2.8, spec §10.2).

``None`` fields stay unchanged; at least one field must be present.
The track entry is created with defaults when absent.
SetTrackSettingsOp.title: SetTrackSettingsOp

SetViewportOp.description: Null clears the stored viewport (editor falls back to fit).
SetViewportOp.title: SetViewportOp

StemRole.description:
Stem roles (spec §3.4, §8.4).

``vocals``/``drums``/``bass``/``other`` mirror the model's declared
source labels (never a hard-coded tensor index). ``others`` is a
publication-only role for the Bass + Others residual
(``reference_mix − bass``), kept distinct from the model's ``other``
stem.
StemRole.title: StemRole

TrackSettings.description: Mixer settings for one stem track (spec §3.5).
TrackSettings.title: TrackSettings

UpdateLoopOp.description:
Partial loop edit; absent fields stay unchanged (M2.11, spec §13.2).

``repeat_count`` distinguishes absent (unchanged) from an explicit
``null`` (infinite) via ``model_fields_set``. The repository
re-validates the resulting range against the duration.

WaveformManifest.description:
On-disk cache manifest (atomic rewrites; progressive availability).

``available_tiles`` maps level index (string) to a sorted list of
inclusive ``[first, last]`` completed-tile ranges. ``final`` is true
only once every level's last tile is published.
WaveformManifest.title: WaveformManifest

WorkingState.description:
Per-project working state persisted by autosave (M1.15 §17.5).

Frame-valued fields are validated against the project's
``duration_frames`` by ``ProjectRecord``.
WorkingState.title: WorkingState

get.description:
Bounded raw PCM window (spec §11.4).

The asset is resolved once; the body, the content hash, and every
metadata header derive from that single resolution.
One binary peak tile (f32le per-channel min/max buckets).
Waveform levels and progressive tile availability (M1.8 manifest).

post.description:
Resolve an existing playback representation or queue its creation.

``ready`` answers with the asset to play; ``preparing`` answers with
the (shared) job that will create the representation. A live job for
the same target rate is reused, never duplicated (spec §6.5.6).
